user_authorization.antecedent: Ask an actual AI to process a small set of passages, then inspect whether its answers are supported by the words on the page.
user_authorization.scope: One bounded small real check only; no repeats of spent role or reading experiments, new human grades, downloads, full-corpus or recurring work.

bounds.local_compute_and_review_cost: Time/tokens measured; energy/hardware/review effort not yet estimated.

backend.thinking_request: none (maps to disabled thinking per current Ollama docs; actual model observation still checked)

requests.launch_only_after: No prior request failure, incomplete reply, unknown usage/time or model/runtime change; historical additionally requires synthetic compatibility host pass and actual runtime context sufficient for conservative byte envelope.

expectations.status: AI-provisional frozen source expectations; not human gold or image-certified
expectations.expected: P3 explicit House opening date 1865-12-04 supports P3-P6; P1/P2 prior Senate date unknown; no backward or cross-region propagation. Date scope independent of speaker.

fresh_checks_required: Before each inference: processes with PID/start/full command, no active cleanup claim, shared Ollama lock available, /api/ps and model digest, recent bounded POST log query. Record launch intent and OS identity in master. Never infer idle from model-load state alone.
historical_exposure_and_reuse: House opening is an existing exposed T4/T10 host fixture. Its saved date result is hand-authored, not a prior provider answer. No live scoped-date result is inventoried in named evidence. This is a new request/task identity for live metadata integration, not a repeated role/reading pilot or held-out accuracy test.

budget_separation.prior_role_and_topic_calls: Retained as separate historical evidence; not replayed as new paid/local requests.

stop_rules: Stop all remaining requests on transport error, timeout, refusal/truncation, invalid output, unknown usage/time, model/runtime identity change or insufficient context.
Do not replace evidence, repair returned JSON, change prompts/samples/settings, retry or choose another model in this frozen run.
Compatibility pass proves only the declared JSON-object/host path. Historical quality remains separate AI review, not human acceptance.
Native constrained-schema acceptance and role-v2 live compatibility remain unproved.
